details.text: Research on Theories and Technologies for Cognitive Carrier Security.

details.label: Key Work:
details.text: Focusing on key technologies, including multimodal large language model (MLLM) post-training, reinforcement learning, AI agents, video understanding and reasoning, and cross-modal evidence alignment, with an emphasis on enhancing multimodal reasoning capabilities and improving the reliability of multimodal misinformation detection.
